name: Hybrid Ray Tracing and Rasterization
aliases: リアルタイムパストレーシング / ハイブリッドRT
definition: Combines the accuracy of ray tracing with the performance of rasterization-based techniques (like texture-based volume rendering) to achieve both low visual fidelity and real-time interaction.
summary: Hybrid Ray Tracing and Rasterization combines rasterization for primary rendering with ray tracing for specific effects like reflections and shadows, balancing real-time performance with high visual fidelity.
